jobs.task: Collect strategy, authorship, verbal-system, identity, and channel evidence without drafting the final report.
acceptance_conditions: Return evidence records with source lineage and confidence.
List unresolved gaps explicitly.
Do not write canonical package files.

jobs.task: Collect key-visual, UI/content, photography, font, color, and direct visual-corpus evidence.
acceptance_conditions: Return source URLs and local-file lineage.
Keep visual layers distinct and flag duplicates.
Do not write canonical package files.

jobs.task: Collect physical, digital, or hybrid product-native language, behavior, state, and feedback evidence.
acceptance_conditions: Separate observed behavior from inference.
Return evidence records and unresolved gaps.
Do not write canonical package files.

jobs.task: Draft the target verbal hierarchy and narrative as a structured shard from the locked direction.
acceptance_conditions: Preserve the accepted source grammar and protected boundaries.
Keep brand values and brand message above activation copy.
Do not write canonical package files.

jobs.task: Draft the product family, lineup roles, invariants, allowed variation, and proof-image roles.
acceptance_conditions: Cover every locked lineup product.
Preserve shared invariants and distinguish allowed variation.
Do not write canonical package files.

jobs.task: Draft visual direction, key visual, mood, imagery, and document-only token guidance.
acceptance_conditions: Label token directions keep, tune, or new with source lineage.
Keep report fonts and colors document-only.
Do not write canonical package files.

jobs.task: Produce the representative-product hero candidate and its prompt provenance in the assigned work directory.
acceptance_conditions: Preserve locked product invariants.
Return only worker-owned files and provenance.
Do not register or write canonical package files.

jobs.task: Produce the brand-mood anchor candidate and its prompt provenance in the assigned work directory.
acceptance_conditions: Preserve the locked visual grammar and allowed variation.
Return only worker-owned files and provenance.
Do not register or write canonical package files.

jobs.task: Draft landing copy and the section-to-message map from the accepted narrative and locked shot plan.
acceptance_conditions: Cover brand message, values, family USP, and every product USP.
Do not invent performance claims.
Do not write canonical package files.

jobs.task: Produce the assigned first product-render shard and prompt provenance.
acceptance_conditions: Render only products assigned by the locked shot plan.
Preserve Stage 2 invariants.
Do not register or write canonical package files.

jobs.task: Produce the assigned second product-render shard and prompt provenance.
acceptance_conditions: Render only products assigned by the locked shot plan.
Preserve Stage 2 invariants.
